signup.lead: Collect at {business}. After {count} visits you get {reward}.
signup.contactHint: Phone or email. One is enough.
signup.consent: Send me the occasional message from {business}.
signup.consentHint: Turn this off later and you keep your stamps.
signup.privacy: {business} only uses your details for this card.

card.toGo: {count, plural, one {One more visit until {reward}.} other {# more visits until {reward}.}}
card.codeHint: Show this code at the counter.
card.scanHint: Have this code scanned at your visit.
card.saveTip: Add this page to your home screen. Then your card is always with you.

lost.title: A new link for your card
lost.lead: Enter the number or address you signed up with. You get a link that works for half an hour.
lost.sent: If we know you, the link is on its way. Check your spam folder too.

reissue.failed: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.

login.title: Sign in
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the owner of the business for a new one.

scan.title: Scan
scan.aim: Point the camera at the customer's code.
scan.noCamera: No camera. Type the code shown under the QR.
scan.redeemHint: Ask for the six digit code on the customer's card.

overview.title: Overview
overview.dueHint: No visit registered within their return period.
overview.many_stamps_one_staff: {staff} gave {count} stamps in the last hour.
overview.balance_mismatch: A balance does not match the ledger. Please contact us.
overview.emptyBody: Once you stamp your first customer, it shows here. Put the signup code by the till first.
overview.emptyExample: Example: Sam, stamp 3 of 10, by Iwan, 14:20.
overview.importHint: CSV with columns first_name, phone and email. Imported customers get no messages until they say yes themselves.

settings.title: Settings
settings.preview: This is how your card looks
settings.name: Business name
settings.colourHint: The text on the card adjusts so it always stays readable.
settings.bookingHint: Customers book here. It has to be an https link.
settings.servicesHint: After how many days does a customer usually come back? That decides who is due for a visit.
settings.servicesEmpty: No services yet. Example: Haircut, 28 days.
settings.signupHint: Print this code and put it by the till. Customers scan it and have their card in half a minute.
settings.inboxHint: A calm list gets done. Ten a day is a good start.

inbox.title: Today
inbox.lead: {count, plural, one {# opportunity} other {# opportunities}} today, at most {limit}. Most important first.
inbox.rhythm: Their own average is every {days} days.
inbox.rewardReason: Earned {reward} on {date} and has not used it yet.
inbox.messageDue: Hi {name}, it has been a while. Fancy a visit to {business}?
inbox.messageReward: Hi {name}, there is still {reward} waiting for you at {business}.
inbox.inPerson: No permission for messages. Mention it to {name} next time you meet.
inbox.ignored: {name} comes back in {days} days if it still applies.
inbox.emptyBody: This shows who is due for a visit or has a reward waiting. In Settings, set after how many days customers usually come back for each service.
inbox.emptyExample: Example: Sam. No visit registered since 12 October. Haircut, usually back after 28 days.

webhook.title: Connect your booking system
webhook.lead: Let your booking system report a completed appointment. The customer then gets a stamp without a scan. Works with any system that can send a signed webhook.
webhook.secretOnce: Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
webhook.mappingHint: Where are the details in your booking system's message? Use dots for nested fields, for example customer.phone.
webhook.completedHint: Several are fine, separated by commas. Only these give a stamp.

waitlist.title: Free slots
waitlist.lead: When a slot that suits you opens up, you get an email. Only for that, nothing else.

slot.title: A slot is free
slot.benefitStamps: {count, plural, one {One extra stamp} other {# extra stamps}}
slot.claimed: The slot is yours. Book it in the calendar now to make it final.
slot.gone: This slot is no longer available.
slot.goneBody: Someone was just ahead of you, or time ran out. You will hear about the next free slot.
slot.benefitNote: You get the benefit at your visit, if it falls within this time.

slots.title: Free slots
slots.lead: Release a slot and let the waitlist fill it. A small group first, the next one only after that.
slots.slow: Alerts go by email for now. That can take a few minutes.
slots.recipients: Who gets it, in this order
slots.noRecipients: Nobody on the waitlist fits this slot.
slots.emptyBody: When an appointment drops out, release it here. Customers on the waitlist get a message, the best fit first.
slots.emptyExample: Example: today 14:30, haircut, bookable until 13:45, two extra stamps.

membership.title: Memberships and bundles
membership.creditsMonth: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} a month
membership.creditsTotal: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}}, valid {days} days
membership.renews: Renews every month. You can cancel any time here on your card; it ends at the end of the paid month.
membership.creditsLeft: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} left
membership.cancelled: Cancelled. You can use it until {date}.
membership.cancelConfirm: Are you sure? The membership stops at the end of this period.

plans.title: Memberships
plans.lead: Regular customers pay ahead and come more often. The money goes straight to your own payment account.
plans.off: Selling stays off until the terms have been checked by a lawyer. You can prepare plans already.
plans.name: Name
plans.noShow: What if a customer does not show
plans.versionNote: Change the price or terms and the plan gets a new version. Whoever bought already keeps the old one.
plans.emptyBody: Start with one membership that suits your regulars.
plans.emptyExample: Example: Haircut membership, 35 euros a month, 2 haircuts.
